terms.comment: Libellus VI describes it as a disc of thin bread with cheese and vegetables.
“A Neapolitan flat cake”: classical placenta and Neāpolītānus (Varr., Plin.), a modern phrase.

phrases.latin: pittam prandērunt, orbem ē pāne tenuī, cāseō, holeribus
phrases.english: they had pizza for lunch, a disc of thin bread, cheese and vegetables
phrases.source: Libellus VI, Reditus: per Alpēs domum

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: p. 360, checked against the searchable text of the book on 29 October 2026.
